quotes.text: In MedQA, it achieves 70.8% with LLaMA 3.3, while the best-performing baseline model records 62.3%.
MedQA comprises 106 simulated diagnostic scenarios, while its extended variant, MedQA Extended, contains 214 distinct cases.

parsed.rationale: Results are reported per benchmark with case counts (slice sizes). No results are broken out by patient demographic subgroup, and no statement says demographic fields are absent; the bias-condition analysis is not a patient-subgroup breakdown. element_flags 2/3.
